alloc_probe/fixed_buffer/aliasProbe.reason: A FixedBufferAllocator over caller-visible memory returns a block inside that memory (native 42); the model's create always returns a fresh disjoint block (0 or OutOfMemory). Fixed by the translated allocator mode.

alloc_probe/page/remapProbe.reason: page_allocator shrinks a []u32 in place and remap returns the slice (native 1); the model's remap of items wider than one byte returns null under every policy.

alloc_probe/arena/remapProbe.reason: ArenaAllocator shrinks its last allocation in place and remap returns the slice (native 1); same model root as page_allocator: non-byte remap always fails in the model.

io_probe/threaded/cancelProbe.reason: Io.Threaded delivers Group.cancel to the waiting task, whose futexWait returns error.Canceled (native 1); the model's cancel is await and its futexWait never cancels, so every schedule deadlocks.

io_probe/single_threaded/handoffProbe.reason: Io.Threaded.global_single_threaded runs Group.async inline, so the task waits for a store that comes after async returns and the program hangs; under the default available spawn policy every task is a new model thread and the hand-off always completes with 5.

iogroup/single_threaded/groupConcurrent.reason: Found by this gate. Io.Threaded.global_single_threaded has no concurrency, so Group.concurrent returns error.ConcurrencyUnavailable; under the default available spawn policy the model's concurrent always assigns a thread. --spawn-policy fallible includes the error. Same root as D-IO-INLINE (THR-02, IOM-01).
